description: React component 'ModelConnectionTest' provides a UI for testing model connection, including initiating an async test, displaying success/error states, and providing troubleshooting info like cURL command. It uses imported functions for network requests and notifications, and manages internal state for test status and error handling.

methods.name: testModelConnection
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous test of the model connection by preparing request data, calling testConnectionRequest, updating UI state based on success/failure, and invoking callback on completion.

methods.name: getCleanErrorMessage
methods.description: Sanitizes error messages by removing stack traces and unnecessary prefixes for clearer display.

methods.name: formatCurlCommand
methods.description: Formats the request data into a curl command string for troubleshooting.
